waybackify ledger [flags] <dir>

Survey the manifests under a tree

Survey the ledger — every wayback.json manifest under <dir>, file
paths as identity. Default: one JSONL row per manifest with section
counts. --flatten: union the ledger into ONE canonical manifest on
stdout (the seen-file bootstrap for manifest). --against: join the
ledger against a cache root, one JSONL row per referenced capture,
classified unfetched | cached | interstitial | error.

Arguments:
  <dir>              root to discover wayback.json manifests under

Flags:
  --flatten          print the union manifest (canonical JSON) instead of rows
  --against <root>   classify referenced captures against this cache root
  --help|-h          Show help

part of the wayback.charlie.dev mirror tooling
